Sandbox_B47MC_CooperativeConsent_tooltip: Enable Medical Checks approval requests. When disabled, the context action uses vanilla approval.
Sandbox_B47MC_Policy_tooltip: Let players choose, require approval every time, remember each examiner after approval, or disable examination requests.
Sandbox_B47MC_DefaultPreference_tooltip: Initial preference for players without a saved choice. Forced server policies override individual choices.
Sandbox_B47MC_Retention_tooltip: Keep approvals across reconnects and restarts, or clear session approvals when either player disconnects. Returning to Persistent reuses stored approvals until revoked.
Sandbox_B47MC_RequestCooldown_tooltip: Minimum delay between examination requests from one examiner.
Sandbox_B47MC_RequestTimeout_tooltip: Time allowed to answer or confirm an examination request before it expires.
Sandbox_B47MC_DebugLogging_tooltip: Write examination request decision codes to the server console for troubleshooting.
